banff.overview: Some of the world's most celebrated hiking through glacier-carved valleys and jagged peaks, with a gondola to the alpine meadows at Sunshine and shuttle reservations needed at Moraine Lake and Lake Louise. Multi-day routes like the 27-mile, 3-day Skyline Trail cross high passes, while day hikes range from easy lakeshore paths to strenuous climbs. In July and August the parks are crowded, especially at Moraine Lake, Lake Louise and Johnston Canyon, where parking fills early. The best conditions run from late June to September.

months.7: The entire network is open, with hiking to glacier views and alpine lakes, but the trails are crowded, and Moraine Lake and Lake Louise need shuttle reservations to manage the volume.

months.11: Trekking conditions stay superb, with crisp, cloudless skies and dry trails across the entire network. Temperatures drop steadily as winter approaches, making the high-altitude tea houses very cold at night.

swissalps.overview: Some of the world's most celebrated hiking, with routes beneath the Matterhorn and surrounding glaciers. The Gornergrat railway, which climbs to 10,135 feet, and a network of cable cars lift hikers to high alpine trails, so a day hike can start far above the valley. The 130-mile Walker's Haute Route from Chamonix to Zermatt is a trek of 12 to 14 days, crossing high passes and valleys. The main hiking season runs from late June to September, when the high trails are clear of snow.

months.11: The transition to winter brings deep snow to the mountains and mud to the valleys, with many cable cars closed for maintenance.

torres-del-paine.overview: Some of the world's most celebrated hiking, known for its granite towers, glaciers, and turquoise lakes. Day hikes start from trailheads reached by bus or catamaran, while the famous W Trek (about 40 miles in 4 to 6 days) and O Circuit (about 80 miles in 7 to 9 days) offer strenuous multi-day routes between refugios. The weather is notoriously windy, and the main trekking window runs from October to April when the trails and huts are fully open.

months.4: A transition month as the trekking window winds down. Snow dusts the higher passes, refugio and campsite availability shrinks, and moderate valley day hikes remain open.
